question: A tradesman allows a discount of 15% on the marked price. How much above the cost price must he mark his goods to gain 19% through the above transaction ?
solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 15%

Profit = 19%

**Formula used:**

(CP)/(MP)=(100-Discount)/(100+Profit)

Percentage = (MP-CP)/(CP)×100

**Calculation:**

According to the formula,

⇒ (CP)/(MP)=(100-15)/(100+19)

⇒​ (CP)/(MP)=(85)/(119)

⇒​ So, CP = Rs. 85

⇒​ MP = Rs. 119

Percentage above CP he has to mark is

⇒​ Percentage = (119-85)/(85)×100

⇒​ Percentage = (34)/(85)×100 = 40%

⇒​ **Hence, The percentage above the cost price he has to mark is 40%**
